comment: The discussion appropriately recognises migrants, refugees, children, and people using different names. It does not address the risk that linking records across sensitive services may expose people to stigma, legal enforcement, discrimination, or unwanted disclosure.

anchor.note: p.116 l.Lines 73-78 read as the printed page; section 2 agrees

public.text: The discussion appropriately recognises migrants, refugees, children, and people using different names. It does not address the risk that linking records across sensitive services may expose people to stigma, legal enforcement, discrimination, or unwanted disclosure.
public.suggestedRevision: Require purpose-specific linkage rules, restricted matching across sensitive contexts, privacy-impact assessment, pseudonymised or segmented identifiers where appropriate, and governance approval for cross-programme linkage.
